snippet.title: Junkyard Fury 3 - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Junkyard Fury 3 is almost ready! Currently planning on a release date of 11/28/2025 for Steam and PlayStation platforms, being both for PS4 and PS5. Xbox will likely be delayed, it's currently in a TBD state, until I can get a better framework in place for it, but can confirm that PC and PlayStation will be ready by then.

Additionally, demos for PlayStation and Steam should now be available!

Steam wishlist: https:/store.steampowered.com/app/3646210/Junkyard_Fury_3/
PlayStation wishlist: https:/store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10015135
